description: Ranked view of the two batch-carrying Ashton hits, for the batch-enumeration test. STOCKED FOR REGISTRATION, not just for realism: rank_search_matches is not in the harness's LIVE_TOOLS, so with no fixture the tool is never registered on the mock server and a call to it is a Type 1 uncovered call — the run ABORTS with unmatched_tool_call at exit 2 and never reaches the judge. search-records/SKILL.md calls it 'the primary triage tool', so the skill is likely to call it, and a judge_context note excusing a fixture_not_found cannot help: that path is never taken. Permissive `{subjectId: ~}` predicate, matching the existing rank-search-matches-* fixtures. Scores are illustrative; the record ids, names, collection titles and batch numbers are carried verbatim from the paired name-search fixture, whose rows were captured live.
